1) update leanVM to move the leaf index out of the XMSS signature, and thus the `verify` functions takes as parameter (pubkey, msg, leaf_index, signature) ? it would work everywhere except for the bid [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/a4d16c5be5e8bf8c5a3fb323ee1cb0293efecb1c/specs/_features/pq/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L1809) that you would need to adapt

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content:
Just thinking out loud:

- the leaf index is only needed when verifying a single signature
- if we have an aggregate proof, then it’s not needed because the proof attests to the fact that the signer did sign the message with some index
- if a validator decides to use an index that it shouldn’t have, then it would not be caught if they also aggregated that signature into a proof, though this seems fine because we mainly care that the validator signed and not exactly what leaf?

excerpts.author: kevaundray
excerpts.content: If this sounds correct, then it seems that we can just ignore the index when verifying aggregates because the protocol mainly cares that an attester signed a message and not what leaf they used?

excerpts.content:
>> if a validator decides to use an index that it shouldn’t have, then it would not be caught if they also aggregated that signature into a proof,  
if useful, we can enforce the index within the STARK proof. but initially I ignored the index because it seemed the easiest option
